title: ZPL label builder for 50x25 mm Zebra labels
interface:
namespace Drupal\hwdesk\Service; final class ZplLabel (declare(strict_types=1); plain PHP, no Drupal dependencies, no constructor arguments).
Public method: build(string $tag, string $model, string $url, int $copies = 1): string -- one ZPL II format for a 50x25 mm label at 203 dpi.
Required structure, in this order, each command on its own line, string ends with "^XZ\n":
^XA
^CI28
^PW400
^LL200
^FO16,16^BQN,2,5^FDQA,<url>^FS        (QR code, model 2, magnification 5; the url verbatim after 'QA,')
^FO170,30^A0N,40,40^FD<tag>^FS          (inventory tag, large)
^FO170,90^A0N,26,26^FD<model>^FS        (model text)
^PQ<copies>
^XZ
Text sanitising for <tag> and <model>: remove the ZPL control characters '^' and '~' and every ASCII control character (bytes < 0x20 and 0x7F) from the text, then truncate the model to 30 characters (mb_substr) — the tag is not truncated; do not alter the url.
copies < 1 -> \InvalidArgumentException. Exactly one ^XA and one ^XZ in the output regardless of copies (copies go through ^PQ only).
